spans.s:
धैर्य 1. धैर्य, अम्, n. (fr. धीर), firmness,
durability, steadiness, stability, strength, consistency,
constancy; calmness; gravity; patience; fortitude,
courage; inflexibility; precision of diction; (Ved.)
intelligence, forethought.
—धैर्य-कलित, अस्, आ,
अम्, assuming firmness or composure, endowed with
calmness.
—धैर्य-ध्वंस, अस्, m. failure of
courage.
—धैर्य-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—धैर्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of firmness or
patience, firm, steady.
—धैर्य-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, of
steady conduct, steadily behaved.
